rows.subject: refactor(material/table): fix strict property initialization errors
rows.reason: The diff in src/material/table/table-data-source.spec.ts changes `@ViewChild(MatSort, {static: true}) sort: MatSort;`. That line is not in the legacy sources. @angular/material/table is exercised by projects/ngx-material-legacy/legacy-table/testing/public-api.ts. The commit is an ancestor of v22.1.7 (e950f29dcfbda93c13bff0d1a632465364488249), so installed peer @angular/material@22.1.7 supplies the change.
